prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Turns out the  flight is a legit maintenance issue. Strange that they said they “need” the plane tho
Delta: So sorry to hear your flight is delayed due to maintenance. Pls DM your confirm # if you need assistance rebooking.  *TJW https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: flight #720 epic fail. Two trips back to gate for maintenance issue, plane switch, and now boarding computer crashes. >2 hr delay now
Delta: ...know. *HWG 2/2

Customer: Stuck overnight,  maintenance problems? I'm also looking at the review of the hotel you put me up in, I'm concerned. 😬
Delta: I regret to learn that your flight has been delayed. Pls let us know if you need further assistance.  *HEC

Customer: Thanks to the flight & cabin crews on Delta 1521 for a nice flight from DAY-ATL this morning.
Delta: Thank you for recognizing our employees. Every day our team is working to make flying with us better! *TDH

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: service_complaint):
"""This is the third time the first flight of the day has a maintenance issue. First flights should never. Check them overnight."""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the repeated inconvenience with early‑day maintenance issues. Please DM your confirmation # so we can look into this further.
